eligibility_summary: Differently-abled student having disability not less than 40% admitted to 1st year degree programme in AICTE approved institution. Income under ₹8 Lakhs.

department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

eligibility_summary: Specially-abled students with >=40% disability enrolled in AICTE recognized polytechnic diploma. Family income under ₹8 Lakhs.

scheme_name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme for Orphans and Wards of Armed Forces
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

benefits: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition fees, books, and stationeries.
eligibility_summary: Candidate admitted to AICTE approved degree or diploma course. Must be orphan / Covid-19 bereaved / ward of martyred personnel. Income under ₹8 Lakhs.

scheme_name: AICTE Post Graduate (PG) Scholarship for GATE / CEED Qualified Students
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Financial assistance to full-time GATE/CEED qualified students admitted to M.E./M.Tech/M.Arch/M.Des programs in AICTE approved colleges.
benefits: ₹12,400 per month for 24 months (total 2 academic years).
eligibility_summary: Must have a valid GATE or CEED scorecard and admission in AICTE approved postgraduate engineering / design program.

scheme_name: AICTE Doctoral Fellowship (ADF) Scheme
department: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
description: Promoting dedicated research culture and quality technical PhD scholars in frontier areas of engineering and technology.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month for first 2 years + HRA; ₹42,000 per month for 3rd year + contingency grant of ₹15,000 per annum.
eligibility_summary: Full-time Ph.D. scholars admitted to ADF research centers with minimum 70% or 7.5 CGPA in both UG and PG engineering degrees.

scheme_name: UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) in Science, Humanities and Social Sciences
department: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Premier national research fellowship awarded to qualifying candidates in the UGC-NET examination for pursuing full-time Ph.D. research.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month (JRF) for 2 years, upgradable to ₹42,000 per month (SRF) for remaining 3 years + HRA and contingency.
eligibility_summary: Qualified in UGC-NET or CSIR-UGC NET for JRF. Admitted to M.Phil/Ph.D. program in a recognized university. Master's degree with minimum 55% marks.

scheme_name: UGC Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region (NER)
department: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Special scholarship scheme to promote higher education and technical studies for students belonging to North Eastern states.
benefits: ₹5,400 per month for General Degree courses and ₹7,800 per month for Technical and Professional courses.
eligibility_summary: Domicile of North Eastern States (Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura). Passed Class 12. Income under ₹4.5 Lakhs.

scheme_name: UGC Post-Graduate Indira Gandhi Scholarship for Single Girl Child
department: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Supporting higher education of girl children who are the only child in the family to pursue post-graduate non-professional or professional studies.
benefits: ₹36,200 per annum for the complete 2-year duration of the Master's degree course.
eligibility_summary: Girl student who is the only child of her parents, admitted to 1st year of regular Master's degree in a recognized university. Age limit 30 years.

scheme_name: UGC Post-Graduate Merit Scholarship for University Rank Holders
department: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Recognizing and incentivizing top university rank holders at the undergraduate level admitted to postgraduate degree programs.
benefits: ₹3,100 per month for 2 years (duration of PG course).
eligibility_summary: First and second rank holders in undergraduate examination from any recognized university, admitted to full-time regular PG course.

scheme_name: UGC Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
department: University Grants Commission (UGC)
description: Research fellowship dedicated to single girl children pursuing Ph.D. research in social sciences and humanities.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month for first 2 years, ₹42,000 per month for subsequent years + contingency grant of ₹10,000/₹12,000 per annum.
eligibility_summary: Single girl child enrolled in regular full-time Ph.D. in Social Sciences in a recognized Indian university.

scheme_name: DST INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: Prestigious national scholarship for students pursuing basic and natural sciences at B.Sc., B.S., and Int. M.Sc. level.
benefits: ₹80,000 per annum (₹60,000 scholarship + ₹20,000 summer research project mentorship grant).
eligibility_summary: Top 1% students in Class 12 board examination or rank in JEE/NEET enrolled in Natural & Basic Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, etc.).

scheme_name: DST INSPIRE Fellowship for Doctoral Research
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: Fellowship for 1st rank holders in university post-graduate examinations in basic sciences and engineering to pursue doctoral research.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month (JRF) + HRA for 2 years, upgradable to ₹42,000 per month (SRF) + contingency grant.
eligibility_summary: INSPIRE Scholar with >=70% aggregate in Master's or 1st rank holder in university level PG examination in science/engineering.

scheme_name: DST INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship Scheme
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: Contractual faculty fellowship offering research independence to young postdoctoral researchers in science and engineering.
benefits: ₹1,25,000 consolidated per month + research grant of ₹7,00,000 per year for 5 years.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens with Ph.D. degree in science, mathematics, engineering, or medical sciences with excellent publication record. Age <= 32.

scheme_name: DST WISE-Ph.D. Fellowship for Women in Science and Engineering
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: Support for women scientists and engineers to pursue Ph.D. in basic and applied sciences, including those with a career break.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month + HRA + contingency grant of ₹1,00,000 per year for up to 5 years.
eligibility_summary: Women candidates possessing M.Sc./M.Tech/MBBS degree who are registered in Ph.D. program. Age 27 to 45 years.

scheme_name: DST WISE-PDF Post-Doctoral Fellowship for Women
department: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: Post-doctoral fellowship providing opportunity to women scientists and technologists with a PhD degree to conduct independent research.
benefits: ₹67,000 per month + HRA + research grant of ₹2,00,000 per year for 3 years.
eligibility_summary: Women scientists with Ph.D. in Science or Engineering. Age 27 to 60 years.

scheme_name: DBT Junior Research Fellowship (DBT-JRF / BET)
department: Department of Biotechnology (DBT)
description: Fellowship awarded via Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET) for pursuing Ph.D. research in Biotechnology and Life Sciences across premier institutes.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month + HRA for 2 years (JRF), upgradable to ₹42,000 per month (SRF) + ₹30,000 annual contingency.
eligibility_summary: M.Sc./M.Tech/B.Tech in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences with minimum 60% marks. Qualified in BET exam.

scheme_name: DBT-Research Associateship (DBT-RA) in Biotechnology & Life Sciences
department: Department of Biotechnology (DBT)
description: National postdoctoral research fellowship for young scientists holding a Ph.D. or MD/MS in biotechnology and biological sciences.
benefits: ₹47,000 to ₹54,000 per month + HRA + research contingency grant of ₹50,000 per annum for 2 years.
eligibility_summary: Ph.D. degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology or related fields with high quality research publications. Age limit 35 (men) / 40 (women).

scheme_name: DBT Ramalingaswami Re-Entry Fellowship
department: Department of Biotechnology (DBT)
description: Prestige re-entry fellowship to bring back Indian researchers working abroad in biotechnology and life sciences to Indian institutions.
benefits: ₹1,00,000 consolidated per month + HRA + research grant of ₹10,00,000 per year for 5 years.
eligibility_summary: Indian scientists working abroad with Ph.D./MD and at least 3 years of postdoctoral research experience overseas. Age <= 45.

scheme_name: CSIR Junior Research Fellowship (CSIR-JRF) & NET Award
department: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
description: Premier fellowship for doctoral research in Chemical, Earth, Life, Mathematical, and Physical Sciences across CSIR labs and universities.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month for JRF (first 2 years), ₹42,000 for SRF (next 3 years) + HRA and annual contingency of ₹20,000.
eligibility_summary: M.Sc. or equivalent degree / Integrated BS-MS / BE / B.Tech / B.Pharma / MBBS with minimum 55% marks. Qualified Joint CSIR-UGC NET.

scheme_name: CSIR Senior Research Fellowship (CSIR-SRF)
department: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
description: Direct SRF award for experienced researchers who have completed at least 2 years of proven research in science and engineering disciplines.
benefits: ₹42,000 per month + HRA + contingency grant of ₹20,000 per year.
eligibility_summary: M.Sc. with 2 years proven research experience, or M.Tech/M.Pharm/MBBS with 1 year research experience, with indexed publications.

scheme_name: CSIR Nehru Science Postdoctoral Research Fellowship
department: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)
description: Elite postdoctoral fellowship for outstanding young PhD holders to conduct high-impact research in CSIR national laboratories.
benefits: ₹65,000 per month + HRA + research contingency grant of ₹3,00,000 per annum for 2 years.
eligibility_summary: Ph.D. in Science or Engineering with exceptional research accomplishments and high-impact publications. Age under 32.

scheme_name: ICMR Junior Research Fellowship (ICMR-JRF) in Biomedical Sciences
department: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
description: National fellowship for postgraduates in biomedical sciences, social sciences, or statistics to pursue Ph.D. research on health priorities.
benefits: ₹37,000 per month + HRA for first 2 years, upgradable to ₹42,000 per month + annual contingency of ₹20,000.
eligibility_summary: Postgraduate degree in basic science (M.Sc.) or post-graduate degree in professional course (M.Tech/MBBS) with 55% marks. Qualified ICMR-JRF test.

scheme_name: ICMR Post-Doctoral Research Fellowship
department: Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
description: Post-doctoral fellowship aimed at fostering high-end biomedical research in ICMR institutes and medical colleges across India.
benefits: ₹65,000 per month + HRA + contingency grant of ₹3,00,000 per annum for 2 years.
eligibility_summary: Ph.D. or MD/MS in relevant medical or biomedical science subjects within 3 years of obtaining degree. Age limit 35 years.

scheme_name: ICAR National Talent Scholarship (UG in Agriculture and Allied Sciences)
department: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)
description: National scholarship awarded to students admitted to undergraduate degree courses in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fisheries, and Veterinary through ICAR AIEEA.
benefits: ₹3,000 per month for the complete 4-year degree duration.
eligibility_summary: Admitted to agricultural university outside their home state through ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission (AIEEA-UG).

benefits: ₹37,000 per month for first 2 years, ₹42,000 per month for 3rd year + HRA and contingency of ₹10,000 per annum.
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in Agricultural/Allied sciences with >= 6.5 OGPA or 65% marks. Qualified ICAR AICE Ph.D. entrance examination.

department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to meritorious SC students for pursuing Master's degree or Ph.D. in accredited foreign universities abroad.
benefits: Full tuition fees + annual maintenance allowance of USD 15,400 (or GBP 9,900) + contingency, visa fees and airfare.
eligibility_summary: SC candidate with unconditional admission offer in top 500 QS world ranked university for Master's or Ph.D. Total family income under ₹8 Lakhs.

scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe (ST) Candidates

description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing complete overseas education funding for ST students pursuing postgraduate and doctoral studies abroad.
benefits: Full foreign tuition fees covered + maintenance allowance (USD 15,400/year), airfare, visa fee and medical insurance.
eligibility_summary: ST student with valid admission offer in top 500 QS ranked university. Family income below ₹6,00,000 per annum.

department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

benefits: Complete waiver of loan interest accumulated during study duration and subsequent 1 year moratorium.
eligibility_summary: OBC or EBC student with education loan sanctioned from scheduled commercial bank for overseas study. Family income under ₹8 Lakhs (OBC) / ₹5 Lakhs (EBC).

department: Ministry of Education
description: Full interest subsidy during moratorium period on educational loans for economically weaker students pursuing professional/technical courses in India.
benefits: 100% interest payable during the moratorium period (course period + 1 year) is borne by the Government of India.

scheme_name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students

scheme_name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Wards of Ex-Servicemen (Kendriya Sainik Board)

scheme_name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme for Railway Protection Force (RPF/RPSF)

scheme_name: Tata Trusts Medical and Healthcare Higher Education Scholarship

scheme_name: Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship for Girl Students

description: Financial assistance for children of registered building and construction workers for school and college education. Implemented for eligible domicile students across Gujarat.
benefits: ₹8,000 to ₹25,000 per year based on educational level.
eligibility_summary: Domicile of Gujarat pursuing UG (General) with minimum 45% marks. Family income within ₹200,000.
